name: vllm-rocm-r9700-main
description: vLLM v0.22.0 compiled from OFFICIAL upstream source (vllm-project/vllm) for AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, RDNA4). Compiled in-place on the existing TheRock gfx1201 torch 2.10/rocm7.13 stack (no official rocm/vllm gfx1201 base exists). Replaces the broken prerelease vllm 0.19.1 wheel whose gfx1201 attention/MoE kernels produce garbage output. Build host 9700x8 (32-core EPYC). ROCm is the _rocm_sdk_devel pip package, so ROCM_PATH/HIP_PATH point there, not /opt/rocm.
